leaks.note: Screens are illustrative recreations of each platform's interface, not client data. Platform names and logos belong to their owners.
leaks.lede: Ranking is not one trick. Each stage below is where visibility is lost, and the SEO work that recovers it.

stages.breaks: Publishing content on a site search engines struggle to read.
stages.why: Slow pages, broken links and blocked resources stop good content from being found, however well it is written.
stages.does: We audit and fix the technical basics: speed, crawlability, mobile usability, page structure and duplicate content.

stages.breaks: Writing about what you want to say, not what people search.
stages.why: Buyers search in stages, from a vague problem to a specific supplier. Content that ignores those stages misses most of them.
stages.does: We map the searches buyers, parents and shoppers make, group them into topics, and plan content that answers each stage.

stages.k: Build pages that rank and convert
stages.breaks: Thin pages that neither rank nor persuade.
stages.why: A page that ranks but does not answer the question or show the next step sends traffic away.
stages.does: We build category, service and landing pages with clear structure, answers and a next step, so traffic becomes enquiries and orders.

stages.breaks: Ignoring how AI assistants pick their sources.
stages.why: More people now ask an assistant instead of scrolling results. Assistants tend to quote pages that give a clear, well-structured answer.
stages.does: We add clear definitions, FAQs and structured data, so that search engines and AI assistants can understand and accurately quote your pages.

stages.why: A ranking that brings no enquiries or sales is not a result. Visibility only matters when it leads to business.
stages.does: We build authority through relevant mentions and links, and report on qualified traffic, enquiries and orders rather than rankings alone.
